uncovered: Pad full user-promise matrix was not executed after the explicit user override.
Pad notification, OS focus, force-stop reconstruction, tamper, cancel, music arbitration, zero-network and final crash gates are NOT_RUN.
Pad is currently at keyguard showing=true and requires the user to unlock before a fresh agent starts.
This isolated harness does not prove production voice-pack import/delete, production ExoPlayer integration, D203 closure or profile license/distribution.
Bluetooth/headset routing, media buttons, other API levels and physical audibility were not tested.
maximumClaim: On the fixed K60 API35 arm64 isolated harness, QA-v5 independently verifies the complete requested runtime matrix: 36/0/0/0 contracts, both approved voices with real AudioTrack/RTF/PSS, a 30-minute all-Asleep window with 165 real AudioTrack starts/completions and truthful FGS/MediaSession/notification/queue progression, actual four-control SystemUI taps, OS-origin LOSS_TRANSIENT without autoplay, paused reconstruction, fail-closed tamper, UI cancel, music/TTS single ownership, offline complete inference with zero UID netstats, zero FATAL/ANR/InputTimeout, zero forbidden TTS requests and clean restoration. This is K60 isolated-harness runtime PASS only. Pad was aborted by explicit user override and is not a PASS; global two-device runtime, production runtime, D203, profile/Q03 and G1 remain unverified/not passed.
